meta.title: Fix memory leak in BackgroundCommandSenderHostedService by using CancellationToken.None
meta.body_summary: Fix memory leak in BackgroundCommandSenderHostedService by replacing the caller's CancellationToken with CancellationToken.None, preventing accumulation of CancellationTokenSource objects under high workflow dispatch loads.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot provided one-line fix with profiler evidence, but maintainer asked for deeper explanation and the PR was closed without merge.

core_change_summary.description: In BackgroundCommandSenderHostedService.cs, changed SendAsync call to use CancellationToken.None instead of commandContext.CancellationToken, preventing retention of caller's CancellationTokenSource and associated memory leak.
